title: ‘Saturday Night Live U.K.’: Here’s Where to Watch the Season 2 Premiere Online
summary: For the season two opener, SNL U.K. has Jeff Goldblum as host and CMAT as musical guest.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

“Live from London, it’s Saturday Night!” Saturday Night Live U.K. season one was a big hit in the United Kingdom and United States, alike, when it first aired in late 2025. And now, for the season two premiere, the sketch comedy show returns with Wicked actor Jeff Goldblum to host, while Irish singer-songwriter CMAT is booked to perform as musical guest .

Although SNL U.K. season two broadcasts live on Saturday (Sept. 12) at 10 p.m. BST on British broadcaster Sky UK, it drops in the U.S. on the following day on Sunday (Sept. 13) at 9 p.m. ET/6 p.m. PT on Peacock .

Meanwhile, Jeff Goldblum doesn’t have a new movie that he’s promoting right now. Instead, he most recently starred in Wicked and Wicked: For Good as The Wonderful Wizard of Oz. As for CMAT, the singer-songwriter released her third album, Euro-Country , in August 2025, while she’s currently touring North and South America for the rest of 2026.
